description: Acapela Cloud REST text-to-speech that streams audio chunks or returns a generated file for a chosen Acapela voice, with optional word, viseme and mark events.

meta.dictionaries: Custom .dic pronunciation dictionaries uploaded to account storage and applied per request.
meta.events: Word positions (wordpos), mouth/viseme positions (mouthpos) and mark positions (markpos) as JSON.
meta.model_id_note: No model parameter: /api/command/ takes a voice name (e.g. <Speaker>22k_HQ). 'acapela-cloud' is the service name.
meta.neural_voices_note: The product page says neural voices are available in real time on request ('contact us'); the public voice list returns only HQ voices.
meta.output_modes: stream (default; audio chunks), file (full audio, or zip with events), events (JSON only)
meta.text_limits: GET requests limited to 2,048 characters; stream output limited to 3,000 characters.
meta.voice_tags: Proprietary inline tags (pause, phonetic \prx, speed, volume, shaping, voice switch, audio mixing) plus SSML.

name: Acapela Cloud TTS
